why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the points page Go to the Noon points page . It shows the points breakdown and the leaderboard.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Use the connect button on the points page so the app can show your rank and count your Noon points.
3 Step 3 : Get USN or sUSN Acquire USN or sUSN through the app. Holding either one earns points under the holdings section.

4 Step 4 : Use a listed integration Pick an activity row on the points page, such as a deposit or liquidity position with sUSN or USN, to earn points on top of holdings. Each row shows its multiplier.
5 Step 5 : Check your points and rank Return to the points page to see your points total and your place on the leaderboard. The docs cover the product in more detail.
